decisions.reason: The request for lights restates the existing accent-lighting requirement without changing its value or scope.

The client mentions exploring a K and requesting silver buttons, but it is unclear whether this revises the existing cursive-K treatment or its beige color, especially because the request is conditional on rebuilding the base.
The source discusses controls, lights, bowl markings, and a possible K on buttons, not the raised-base logo treatment.
Silver buttons may supersede the current green dispense-button and beige-lettering colors, but the source may instead refer to separate decorative controls and is conditional on a new base.
The source does not change the machine brand text, placard faces, or use of the same text on both sides.
The observation that AI-rendered proportions cannot be matched exactly does not change the selected bowl capacity, compact form, or mixing-related capacity priorities.
Liking the rendered power button is consistent with the existing dedicated centered power-control requirement and establishes no new placement or behavior.
The source contains no decision about splash behavior or splash-control methods.
The requested visual controls and lighting do not change the whisk head, material, size, or positioning criteria.
The visual-design decision does not alter the required smoothness, frothiness, or high-speed mixing behavior.
The source does not change solenoid actuation, valve behavior, dripping prevention, or pre-dispense isolation.
The general caveat about AI-rendered proportions does not revoke or modify the required spout orientation, downward pour direction, or render-inspired geometry.
